FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Specialist Corps
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: A formal specialist program that invests in training and capacity. Settlements can host more specialists, they learn faster, and their contributions are more impactful.

positiveEffects.li: - Specialists gain XP twice as fast

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Meritocratic
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: A society that rewards competence. Skilled governors are far more effective, but their higher status demands greater compensation.

positiveEffects.li: - Governor focus bonuses are stronger and scale harder with skill

negativeEffects.li: - Governor upkeep increased to x3 (from x2)

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Professional Army
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: Commanders are trained career soldiers. Their military contributions are doubled and they provide greater protection to civilians.

positiveEffects.li: - Casualty reduction from each Commander is doubled

FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.label: Garrison Doctrine
FactionColonies.FCPolicyDef.desc: A standing garrison doctrine that keeps Commanders safe and boosts settlement morale through visible security.

positiveEffects.li: - Commanders die half as often when a settlement is attacked
